sentences.text:
Shubhadeep Giri @ Shubhadip & Ors vs The State Of West
Bengal & Anr on 1 April, 2026
01.04.2026
Sl. no. 19
Ct. No. 42
 P.M.
 Crr 1181 Of 2026
Shubhadeep Giri @ Shubhadip & Ors.

- Vs -
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Rajdeep Mazumder, Sr. Adv
 Mr. Pritam Roy,
 Mr. Sayan Mukherjee,
 Ms. Triparna Roy
 ... for the petitioners
 Mr. Arkadyuti Pahari,
 Ms. Gargi Maity,
 Mr. Alik Mandi
 ... for the defacto complainant.

1.
Present petition has been filed for quashing of the Contai Woman Police Station Case No. 06 of
2026 dated 31st January, 2026 under Sections 109/ 115(2)/126(2)/304(2)/351(2)/74/3(5) of Bnss.
2.

Learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that there is a long history of complaint and counter complaint between the complainant parties and the petitioners.
3.

Learned senior counsel submits that earlier the opposite party No. 2 had lodged a false and frivolous case against the petitioner bearing First Information No. 4 of 2023 under Section 376(2)(n)/506/34 of Indian Penal Code and 4 of the POCSO Act.
4. Learned senior counsel submits that the trial of this case is pending and the opposite party No. 2 is delaying the same for one reason or the other.

5. Learned senior counsel further submits that while the matter rested this, regarding the incident dated 25th January, 2026, the petitioners lodged an FIR No. 28 of 2026 under Sections 109/115(2)/117(2)/ 126(2)/3(5)/303(2)/351(2) of BNSS against the opposite party No. 2.
6.

Learned senior counsel submits that regarding the same incident a false and frivolous complaint w a s m a d e b y o p p o s i t e p a r t y N o . 2 b e a r i n g F I R N o . 6 o f 2 0 2 6 u n d e r S e c t i o n s 109/115(2)/126(2)/304(2) / 351(2)/74/3(5) of the BNSS.
7. Learned senior counsel submits that FIR No. 6 of 2026 is a false and frivolous FIR and has been moved just to harass the petitioner and is an abuse of process of law.

sentences.text: SCC Online SC 454.

9. Learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 has vehemently opposed the plea and submits that the petitioner No. 1 is the main kingpin who is abusing the process and is harassing the opposite party No. 2 and her family.
10. Learned counsel submits that the offence alleged against the petitioners are serious and it needs thorough investigation.

11. Learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 also submits that a petition has also been filed by the opposite party No. 2 bearing WPA 6068 of 2026 for transfer of investigation of FIR No. 6 of 2026 from Contai Woman Police Station to some independent Investigating Agency.
12. The court considers that the matter is required to be heard in detail.
13. Let the notice be issued to the State of West Bengal through office of the Public Prosecutor.
State is directed to file a detailed report and produce the Case Diary.
14. In the meanwhile the petitioners are directed to join the investigation as and when directed by the I.O.
15. Let the matter be listed on 28th April, 2026.
16. In the meanwhile no coercive action be taken if the petitioners duly join the investigation and cooperate with the investigation.

(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
